_about: The model-curated frontal set: clips where the boxer_facing_angle model says the boxer faces the camera. clip = span >= min_sec whose aggregate share of frontal frames (|angle| <= band_deg; no pose = not frontal) exceeds min_frac -- method 'maximal' = all maximal scoring segments of (frontal - min_frac), Ruzzo & Tompa 1999; 'window' = union of qualifying min_sec windows. Frames are cache frames of that BlazePose round; seconds are the round's _pts.npy clock. Written by cornerman-backend ml/frontal_auto.py.
